verdict.rationale: Skills are instruction and script packages that Claude loads when relevant or when invoked with `/skill-name`. Nothing in the pack shows Skills itself letting a user set up automations that run on their own in the background, such as scheduled or triggered runs. The 'agent view' background sessions belong to the host platform (Claude Code), not to Skills, and the 'automating personal tasks' line describes a kind of task, not unattended background execution.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
